name: ONE_LANE_WHITE_SQUARE
notes: TMR Queensland design sheet (Q-series book / TC-series), colour drawing 'not to scale' with a lettered dimension table; every dimension from the sheet, AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. The sheets give no letter widths, so there is no width check. Sheet 'c' is the white edge and 'd' the edge + border (read as AS 1743 does: 10/30 = edge 10 + border 20, 5/15 = 5 + 10, 15/45 = 15 + 30), confirmed against the national R-series pairs. Q-series sheet RM9-9-Q01 'One lane' multi-message sign plates (2025), upper plate RM9-9-Q01A 600 x 600. Multi-message sign plate: black border 25, square corners, no edge strip (as the national RM plates). Chain 130 / 120D / 100 / 120D / 130 = 600: cap tops 130 and 350. Black on white.
